method: Independent needs-to-understand review against each glossary context's blocked_future_concepts, prerequisites, required facts and teaching text. Passing future-concept mentions are not leakage. No deterministic gates were rerun and no generator reasoning or prior evaluator findings were used.

coverage.text_review: Exhaustive across lesson and remediation blocks, including nested visual labels, alt text, code scaffolding, annotations, table captions and recap previews.
coverage.sampling_rationale: One interaction per tile (9 of 22), expanded by two additional interactions to cover all three sequential deployment concepts in tile 090. Prompts, options/items/tasks and feedback were reviewed for comprehension dependencies.

review_notes: Tile 089's experiment limits, supplied abort/stop path and recovery observations are taught by its own glossary facts and example; understanding later incident approval, audit or isolated restoration procedures is unnecessary.

Tile 090 teaches Lambda, EKS and EC2 blue/green operations in separate sequential segments. Earlier segments do not require understanding the later deployment mechanism. The final recap follows all three teachings. Supplied result/readiness/behavior checks do not require designing the later smoke-check gate or diagnosing container health failures.
Tile 093's finally placement and exercise-created identity scoping are current required facts, not a dependency on the later cost teardown concept. No residual-charge verification is required.

Tiles 094 and 095 use supplied Terraform approval/apply workflows and their current drift/module facts; learners need not understand later backend configuration, locking, state-access isolation or replacement controls.

Tiles 096 and 097 use read-only registered baseline and finding evidence. Neither requires later pricing, forensic evidence integrity, retention policy, incident documentation or automated event routing knowledge.
Tile 098 uses supplied target parameters and permissions plus matching/nonmatching observations; later retry and failed-delivery capture mechanisms are not needed.
Tile 099 checks desired-count restoration after controlled removal without requiring later ECS rollout, task-identity or health-diagnosis mechanisms.
Up-next titles mention future concepts but contain no explanation or task that requires understanding them. They are permitted passing mentions.
summary: No BLOCKING or ADVISORY leakage defects found in the exhaustive text review and expanded interaction sample.
